reason: Clearing debris seems like a useful start to repairing the wound.
expectation: Phagocytes will clear some debris around the sealed wound, preparing the area for repair.

alternatives.reason: A nearby blood supply also seems useful for repair, but I want to address the wound debris first.

effect: The wound is cleaned around the clot, so I can move on to supporting tissue repair.
reaction: The result matched my expectation, though it added little explanation.
reason: Repair signals acting on a nearby capillary may help establish the blood supply needed for healing.
expectation: The capillary will grow or extend toward the wound, though I am unsure how the game will represent that.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts could build supporting tissue, but I want to address the blood supply first.

effect: The repair signals produced a new vessel branch connected to the existing circulation, which I can now add to the wound.
reaction: The sprout matched my expectation, and its connection to the parent vessel is clear.
reason: Adding the sprout to the cleaned wound seems like the next step toward supplying the repair site.
expectation: The wound will gain a growing blood supply, though I am unsure whether the vessel is functional yet.

alternatives.reason: Fibroblasts could start building support, but I want to connect the new vessel first.

effect: The wound now has connected capillary branches and needs both surface and support layers.
reaction: The empty slots make the next tasks clear, though the picture describes completed overlays before they are fitted.
reason: Fibroblasts and nutrients seem likely to make the deeper support needed for the wound.
expectation: The fibroblasts will produce collagen-rich connective tissue that can be fitted into the support slot.

alternatives.reason: Surface cells also need to close the wound, but I want to build the underlying support first.

effect: The fibroblasts produced new connective tissue, ready to fill the wound's support slot.
reaction: The collagen fibres make the tissue's supporting role clear.
reason: I want to add the new support to the healing wound.
expectation: The connective tissue will fill the support slot beneath the still-open surface.

alternatives.reason: The surface also needs repair, but I want to fit the support I just made first.

effect: The new connective tissue now fills the wound's support slot; the surface still needs repair.
reason: This is the only available combination, and the edge cells should help close the surface.
expectation: The nourished epidermal cells will form a new surface that can be fitted over the wound.

effect: The epidermal cells formed a new surface that can fill the remaining slot.
reaction: The picture clearly shows the cells extending across the gap.
reason: This is the only available combination, and fitting the surface should close the wound.
expectation: The new surface will cover the wound above the connective tissue, completing the closure and support goal.

effect: The new surface is fitted and the wound is closed and supported; the temporary clot still needs clearing.
reason: The only available combination addresses the remaining goal of clearing the clot.
expectation: The enzymes will break down the temporary fibrin clot while the repaired tissue remains in place.

effect: The temporary fibrin has mostly cleared, leaving closed skin and a scar that is still maturing. Both goals are complete.
reaction: The remaining scar made the ending feel more realistic than an instant return to uninjured skin.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building and fitting the connective tissue was worthwhile: the fibroblasts laying collagen made the wound's deeper support concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early cleaning result was clear but brief, and the later fitting steps felt procedural.

surprise.text: The healing-skin picture described the completed surface and support overlays before either was fitted, which made the construction's current state confusing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely purposeless, though combining edge cells with nutrients gave little explanation of how the new surface formed.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing for more connections between body systems, though the predictable fitting steps made this chapter feel more like assembling an illustration than making meaningful decisions.
